sections.text: Standby while production department used another well to equalize and open DHSV.
Opened DHSV and SV. WHP 69 bar.
RIH w/ run guns w/ tractor), 3,375" od guns by gravity from surface to 600 m.
Schlumberger performed communication check with toolstring. Meanwhile, held well contol exercise with WL crew. Scenario leakage in QTS with BHA at 1500 mmd.

Continue to RIH with BHA from 600 mmd to hud at 2810 mmd taking PUW every 500m. Depth PUW sim PUW HW 1000 2810 2511 2360 1500 3600 3258 3200 2000 4300 4279 3840 2500 5400 5482 4919 actual friction factor 0. 289.
Activated tractor and continued to RIH with from 2810 mmd to 3550 mmd Average running speed w/ tractor 9 m/min. Depth PUW sim PUW 3050 5450 5950 3300 5600 6270
Contined to RIH with tractor activated to 3642 mmd. Tractor seemed to struggle. Shut down tractor, picked up full weight and slacked off 10m. Started tractor again and RIH to 3740 mmd.
Performed orientation pass Some stick and slip observed. Increased tractor arm force.
Continued to RIH with tractor activated to 3900mmd. Performed orientation pass and stopped tractor.
Performed correlation logging from 3900 mmd to 3600 mmd.
Activated tractor and RIH to 3710 mmd. Tractor stalled out.
Switched to logging mode. Performed correlation pass from 3710 mmd to 3600 mmd.
Activated tractor and RIH to 3710 mmd. Tractor stalled out at same depth as previously.
Switched to logging mode and performed correlation pass. Positioned gun 1 with bottom shots at 3684 mmd.
Perforated interval 3675 3684 mmd and lost 250 lbs on tension. WHP before/ after 79,0 79,9 bar. A-annulus before after 12,4 12,1 bar.
Performed correlation pass for gun while pulling out to 3438 mmd.
Activated tractor and RIH to 3562 mmd while performing correlation pass for gun
Switched to logging mode and performed correlation pass. Positioned gun 2 with bottom shots at 3481 mmd.
Perforated interval 3475 3481 mmd and lost 400 lbs on tension. WHP before/ after 81,2 81,7 bar. A-annulus before after 12,0 12,0 bar.
POOH to 3300 mmd while correlating depth.
POOH from 3300 m to surface. WHP 84 bar.
Closed and inflow tested SV. Closed HMV. Valve needed to be greased before test.
Waited while production department greased HMV.
Closed and inflow tested HMV. Purged lubricator with n2.
Held toolbox meeting prior to l/d BHA with explosives.
Broke lubricator and l/d BHA guns w/ tractor). Confirmed all shots fired.
M/u dummy BHA for testing lubricator. Installed and stabbed lubricator. Attempted to leak tested QTS. Found leakage in a o-ring.
Changed damaged o-ring in lubricator and leak tested same to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
Closed DHSV and opened HMV. Bled down pressure in tubing to 10 bar.
Inflow tested DHSV with 74 bar DP. Pressure increased 0,1 bar/30min.
Bled off pressure above DHSV before disconnecting lubricator.
